sessions.context: A three-turn open-and-confirm exchange is rewritten from a garage door to the vehicle sunroof while preserving its dialogue acts.

turns.text: Open the sunroof.

source_trace.original_text: Open the garage.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Just to confirm, do you want the sunroof fully opened now?

source_trace.original_text: Confirm. Do you want the garage door opened now?

turns.speaker: co_user
turns.text: Yes. Open it fully now. Fully open is also my normal sunroof position for cabin venting.
